QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(foo)` expands to `private_foo`. ... With the define, it expands to `foo` and the name is visible again.

WHY: The answer states both the default rename to private_<member> and the unchanged expansion when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined.
